studies.label: Trypsin-Benzamidine unbiased MD (ACEMD) + Markov state model

method_details.value: Unbiased MD with adaptive, manually selected restarts from under-sampled states, analysed with a Markov state model (pyEMMA): inter-residue-pair distances, TICA projection on 5 slowest components, 139 uniform-distance clusters split by Asp189-Benzamidine distance (6 Å) into 237 microstates, maximum-likelihood reversible transition matrix at lag time 30 ns, PCCA++ into 7 metastable sets, transition path theory; frames every 100 ps; combined with 491 x 100 ns trajectories from ref. 23 for 149.1 μs total
